description: Resume collection for a paused item. The result's collection field says what will collect it: monitor, prepaid or subscription (collected from the next scheduled run; prepaid runs are paid from Workspace funds and wait when funds are short), or manual (only on request). Items whose platform cannot collect in their region (TikTok in CN or HK) stay paused and return UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_REGION; report that reason rather than retrying. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.
